0.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025GUIDE_00940_GUIDEXMS2025_000_000
0.description: A very merry Starlight to you, friend! Should you have any questions about the Starlight Celebration, it would be my pleasure to assist.
0.translation_description: Ti auguro una splendida Celebrazione delle Stelle, amico! Se hai domande al riguardo, sarò felice di aiutarti.

3.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025GUIDE_00940_A1_000_002
3.description: What's your task in all this?

5.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025GUIDE_00940_GUIDEXMS2025_000_010
5.description: The Starlight Celebration can be traced back to ancient Ishgard. Long ago, a terrible battle claimed countless lives, leaving thousands of children orphaned in the harsh cold weather of Coerthas.
5.translation_description: La Celebrazione delle Stelle ha origine nell’antica Ishgard. Molto tempo fa, una terribile battaglia causò innumerevoli vittime, lasciando migliaia di bambini orfani nel rigido clima del Coerthas.

6.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025GUIDE_00940_GUIDEXMS2025_000_011
6.description: Unable to bear their suffering, Ishgardian knights would offer these children board and lodging within their barracks. Of course, this was expressly forbidden, but the knights devised a plan to sneak them in, disguising the children in jackets of their scarlet uniforms.
6.translation_description: Per non lasciarli soffrire, i cavalieri ishgardiani accolsero quei bambini nelle loro caserme, offrendo loro vitto e alloggio. Era severamente vietato, naturalmente, ma i cavalieri idearono un piano per introdurli di nascosto, travestendoli con le giacche scarlatte delle loro uniformi.

7.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025GUIDE_00940_GUIDEXMS2025_000_012
7.description: Owing to their generosity, the children survived the winter and lived to pay forward the kindness they had received. The former orphans would adorn themselves in scarlet uniforms, delivering gifts to children on the coldest week of the year. Thus, the Starlight Celebration was born.
7.translation_description: Grazie alla loro generosità, i bambini sopravvissero all’inverno e poterono ricambiare la gentilezza ricevuta. Gli orfani di un tempo indossavano uniformi scarlatte e portavano doni ai bambini durante la settimana più fredda dell’anno. Nacque così la Celebrazione delle Stelle.

8.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025GUIDE_00940_GUIDEXMS2025_000_013
8.description: Over the years, the celebration has undergone gradual changes. The snowy-bearded captain of the kind-hearted knights has become known as the “Saint of Nymeia,” and children believe that he delivers their hopes and prayers directly to the goddess Herself.
8.translation_description: Con il passare degli anni la celebrazione è cambiata. Il capitano dalla barba bianca di quei cavalieri dal cuore gentile è diventato noto come il «Santo di Nymeia», e i bambini credono che porti le loro speranze e preghiere direttamente alla dea.

9.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025GUIDE_00940_GUIDEXMS2025_000_014
9.description: Similarly, his red-jacketed knights have become the “saint's little helpers.” They are particularly beloved by the younglings, for it is their role to bring gifts to every child who sends a prayer to the Spinner.
9.translation_description: Anche i suoi cavalieri dalle giacche rosse sono diventati i «piccoli aiutanti del Santo». I bambini li adorano, perché portano doni a chiunque preghi la Tessitrice.

10.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025GUIDE_00940_GUIDEXMS2025_000_020
10.description: My scarlet-clad colleagues and I have been charged by the Adventurers' Guild with running the Starlight Celebration. The festival spans the entire realm of Eorzea, and we have little helpers stationed in the cities of Gridania, Limsa Lominsa, and Ul'dah.
10.translation_description: La Gilda degli Avventurieri ha incaricato me e i miei colleghi dagli abiti scarlatti di organizzare la Celebrazione delle Stelle. La festa coinvolge tutta Eorzea, con piccoli aiutanti nelle città di Gridania, Limsa Lominsa e Ul’dah.

11.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025GUIDE_00940_GUIDEXMS2025_000_021
11.description: For this year's festivities, we are pleased to bring back the Starlight Stalls. The market is held in Gridania beneath an open sky, and caters to children and grown-ups alike. I hope that you'll enjoy it!
11.translation_description: Quest’anno siamo lieti di riproporre le Bancarelle di Luce Stellare. Il mercato si tiene a Gridania all’aperto ed è pensato per grandi e piccini. Spero che ti divertirai!
